universities.research_notes: IFC list (25 chapters) sourced from the official UW IFC site, uwifc.com/fraternities, which was reachable and fully rendered, and roughly matches FSL's own stated count of '25+ IFC fraternities.' However, fsl.wisc.edu's own council pages (councils overview, NPHC page, MGC page, organizations directory) are heavily JavaScript-rendered, so a plain page fetch returned only partial/skeleton content rather than full chapter rosters -- this is flagged explicitly rather than papered over.
